source.view: Total Spend, grouped by Line Item, 1d buckets, range Oct 05 to Oct 12 2026
source.note: Dashboard figures, not an invoice. Not admitted by scripts/import_openai_costs.py, which needs native Costs API pages grouped by project_id.

stageAttribution.basis: which model each stage called this week; not measured per request
stageAttribution.gpt-transcribe: Layer 1 reference ASR (other same-day users, if any, are not excluded)
stageAttribution.gpt-6_1-sol: Layer 2 translation and review, and text QC back-translation run with --text-backend api

ledgerReconciliation.method: copies of all six Layer 1 source-budget ledgers migrated to v3 with SourceBudget.migrate_to_v3 (no provider calls); originals unchanged

gpt-6-astra.finding: Estimate matches the bill. The frozen worst-case input rate (12.5 USD per million) is Astra's cache-write rate, and the bill books essentially all input as cache writes.

gpt-transcribe.finding: Billed exceeds the 48 calls' reservation. Settlement reads token counts, but ASR responses report usage as {type: duration, seconds}, so every ASR row settles unknown. Whether the excess is another same-day caller or a price above the frozen assumption is not established.

gpt-6_1-sol.finding: Not reconciled per request: its ledgers are the canonical Layer 2 budget and the text QC API ledger. Cache writes are 41% of the Sol spend. The frozen worst-case input rate (2.5) equals Sol 6.1's cache-write rate, so worst-case estimates cover caching.
gpt-6_1-sol.ratesSource: scripts/experiments/benchmark_layer2_bounded.py PRICES (repository table, not re-verified against the price page)
gpt-6_1-sol.comparison: The retrospective's tally from cached replies (text QC 8.74M + Layer 2 0.5M tokens) is about a third of the roughly 31M tokens these line items imply.
